title.narrative: Integrating DonorFinanced Health Programs Multi Donor Trust Fund

description.narrative: The development objective of the multi-donor trust fund (MDTF) is to support countries in strengthening their health systems to accelerate and sustain progress towards key health outputs and outcomes that contribute to UHC with a particular focus on assessing and supporting the financial and institutional sustainability of donor-financed health programs.
